# Radio

A set of checkable buttons—known as radio buttons—where no more than one of the buttons can be checked at a time.

- **Import:** `import { RadioGroup, RadioGroupItem } from "@kozmos-ds/react";`
- **Group:** Core
- **Platforms:** React, SwiftUI and Compose; linked to its Figma component through Code Connect.
- **Storybook:** <https://vodoco.github.io/kozmos-design-system/storybook/?path=/docs/components-radiogroup--docs>

## Example

From its `Default` story.

```tsx
import { RadioGroup, RadioGroupItem, ThemeProvider } from "@kozmos-ds/react";

export function RadioExample() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="light">
      <RadioGroup defaultValue="option-one">
        <RadioGroupItem value="option-one" id="option-one" label="Option One" />
        <RadioGroupItem value="option-two" id="option-two" label="Option Two" />
      </RadioGroup>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## RadioGroup

It forwards its ref to `HTMLDivElement`. Its props are `RadioGroupProps`, which extends `React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof RadioGroupPrimitive.Root>`.

- `label`: `string`, optional.
- `error`: `boolean | string`, optional.
- `wrapperClassName`: `string`, optional.
- `defaultValue`: `string`, optional.
- `dir`: `RovingFocusGroupProps['dir']`, optional.
- `asChild`: `boolean`, optional.
- `disabled`: `React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof Radio>['disabled']`, optional.
- `value`: `string | null`, optional.
- `name`: `RadioGroupContextValue['name']`, optional.
- `loop`: `RovingFocusGroupProps['loop']`, optional.
- `orientation`: `RovingFocusGroupProps['orientation']`, optional.
- `required`: `React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof Radio>['required']`, optional.
- `onValueChange`: `RadioGroupContextValue['onValueChange']`, optional.
- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## RadioGroupItem

It forwards its ref to `HTMLButtonElement`. Its props are `RadioGroupItemProps`, which extends `React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof RadioGroupPrimitive.Item>`.

- `label`: `string`, optional.
- `error`: `boolean`, optional, default `false`.
- `asChild`: `boolean`, optional.
- `value`: `string`, **required**.
- `checked`: `boolean`, optional.
- `required`: `boolean`, optional.
- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).
